description: Manage Render cloud services - deploy, monitor, scale, and troubleshoot services

tools.name: render_deploy_service
tools.description: Deploy a Render service (web service, worker, cron job). Can deploy specific commit (Git) or image tag (Docker). Optionally wait for deploy to complete.

commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA to deploy (Git-backed services only). Optional - uses latest commit if omitted.

image_url.description: Docker image URL with tag/digest (image-backed services only). Optional - uses :latest if omitted.

wait.description: Wait for deploy to complete before returning. Default: true

returns.description: Deploy details including deploy ID, status, start time, duration

tools.name: render_get_service_logs
tools.description: Get recent logs from a Render service. Supports filtering by time range and log level. Useful for debugging, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

tail.description: Number of recent log lines to return. Default: 100, max: 10000

filter.description: Filter logs by text pattern (case-insensitive). Optional.

returns.description: List of log entries with timestamp, level, message

tools.name: render_restart_service
tools.description: Restart a Render service instance. Useful for recovering from errors, applying configuration changes, or clearing memory leaks. Triggers a rolling restart with zero downtime.

wait.description: Wait for restart to complete. Default: true

returns.description: Restart status with timestamp and instance details

tools.name: render_list_services
tools.description: List all Render services in workspace with status, type, and URLs. Useful for inventory, monitoring, and service discovery.

service_type.description: Filter by service type: web_service, private_service, background_worker, cron_job. Optional - returns all if omitted.

status.description: Filter by status: live, suspended, failed. Optional.

returns.description: List of services with ID, name, type, status, URL, last deploy time

tools.name: render_get_service_metrics
tools.description: Get current CPU, memory, and request metrics for a service. Useful for performance monitoring, capacity planning, and troubleshooting.

returns.description: Metrics including CPU usage %, memory usage (MB/GB), request count, p95 latency

tools.name: render_scale_service
tools.description: Scale a Render service (change instance count or type). Useful for handling traffic spikes or optimizing costs.

num_instances.description: Number of instances to run (1-10). Optional - uses current if omitted.

instance_type.description: Instance type (e.g., standard, standard_plus, pro). Optional.

returns.description: Updated service configuration with new scale settings

tools.name: render_get_deploys
tools.description: List recent deploys for a service with status, duration, and commit info. Useful for tracking deployment history and debugging failed deploys.

limit.description: Number of deploys to return. Default: 10, max: 100

returns.description: List of deploys with ID, status (live/failed), created_at, finished_at, duration, commit

tools.name: render_postgres_backup
tools.description: Trigger a manual backup of a Render Postgres database. Backups are stored for 30 days (Standard tier).

database_id.description: Render Postgres database ID (e.g., dpg-abc123). Required.

returns.description: Backup details with ID, timestamp, size, status
